title: Among female patients with uric acid at or above the upper limit of normal
question: Among female patients with uric acid at or above the upper limit of normal (UA ≥ 6.5), find those who also have white blood cell counts within the normal range (3.5 < WBC < 9.0). Return their IDs and anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentrations (IgG, IgM, IgA) from any examination record, but only for those whose IgM level is greater than the average IgM of this group.

prediction.sql:
WITH QualifyingPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P."XCL_058" AS PatientID
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
      AND L."XCL_022" >= 6.5
      AND L."XCL_030" > 3.5
      AND L."XCL_030" < 9.0
),
GroupAvgIgM AS (
    SELECT AVG(L."XCL_042") AS AvgIgM
    FROM QualifyingPatients QP
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON QP.PatientID = L."XCL_014"
)
SELECT P."XCL_058" AS ID,
       L."XCL_041" AS IgG,
       L."XCL_042" AS IgM,
       L."XCL_043" AS IgA
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN QualifyingPatients QP ON P."XCL_058" = QP.PatientID
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN GroupAvgIgM G ON 1=1
WHERE L."XCL_042" > G.AvgIgM

)

INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN GroupAvgIgM G ON 1=1
WHERE L."XCL_042" > G.AvgIgM
